## Provenance checklist

- [ ] Every new or changed parameter has a row in `ledger/parameters.csv`
- [ ] Every row cites a Tier A/B source, or is marked `assumed` with written justification
- [ ] Sources used are within the whitelist in `SOURCES.md`
- [ ] No excluded artifact was consulted in producing this change
- [ ] Module header blocks cite the literature the structure came from
- [ ] No published figure has been reproduced; any diagrams are original

## If this touches numerics or performance

- [ ] Validation suite results before/after attached
- [ ] Conservation invariants still hold to stated tolerance
- [ ] Benchmark: wall-clock and step count, before/after
- [ ] Trajectories that changed are listed, with rationale for why the change is correct
